name: TalentXperience 2026

plan.title: Register and check signage
plan.detail: Collect the physical Talent Passport. Confirm today’s rooms and any programme changes.

plan.title: Ailytics
plan.detail: Lead with BugRaid deployments and Primech IoT. Qualify junior DevOps, networking expectations, non-credit placement and EP support.

plan.title: Ajentik AI
plan.detail: Ask about a funded AI/backend internship with one owned deliverable. Use TalkToIt and ResearchAgent; clarify sponsorship early.

plan.title: Move to Beacon
plan.detail: Allow the floor change; if a queue has delayed you, leave with a contact instead of missing the talk.

plan.title: SAP Fioneer sharing session
plan.detail: First presentation sticker. Ask which project is genuinely engineering-led, and whether the verified BA internship offers technical implementation.

plan.title: Fano Labs
plan.detail: Discuss the four-month late-October intake. Ask how much is coding/POC evaluation versus presales, then confirm work-pass support.

plan.title: Keysight
plan.detail: Ask about EDA requisition 54397, the electronics learning gap and any successor software/AI automation roles. Do not use expired 54365 as an active lead.

plan.title: Yokogawa · fifth booth / backup
plan.detail: A short qualification conversation on industrial software/data projects. If no suitable opening or sponsor route, end early. Five planned booths now complete.

plan.title: Buffer and move to Inspire
plan.detail: Save notes and prepare the Rezonate question. Use only spare time for follow-up; avoid starting another talk.

plan.title: Rezonate sharing session
plan.detail: Protect this session. Ask about the engineering internship’s GPA gate, paid scope and EP path during Q&A; request a named technical follow-up if possible. Second presentation sticker.

plan.title: Brief speaker follow-up if available
plan.detail: Ask permission for a short conversation; if the speaker is busy, take the team’s submission route. Do not assume a formal interview will happen today.

plan.title: Lunch and shortlist
plan.detail: Use the physical passport for lunch. Export notes, check ITS and prioritise the leads with confirmed placement and sponsorship pathways.

source_note: Booths and talks follow the supplied student briefing, physical pages 7–8. The public event page currently lists a different talk programme and a different organisation name in place of Octomate; confirm signage on arrival. The briefing prints 11:30–12:00 AM for the final sessions; shown here as midday within the stated morning event.
after_event: CV submission and internship interviews take place after TalentXperience. Check ITS for submission instructions; shortlisted students are invited for interviews.
